logic.title: Confluences
logic.text: Key level: A round number, previous-day high/low or the broken structure level sits inside the zone, so more orders cluster there. Fib: The zone overlaps the 0.618 to 0.705 retracement of the impulse leg: the classic "discount" area where pullbacks often end. MTF EMA: Price is on the trend side of the 9 EMA on the trigger timeframe and the one above it, so the timeframes agree.

logic.title: Stop-loss
logic.text: SL 866.60 sits above the order block and the pullback extreme with a 0.25 ATR buffer. If price trades through it, the 5m structure is broken and the idea is wrong, so you leave with a small, planned loss. Risk to the stop is 0.7% of price.

logic.title: Targets
logic.text: T1 855.60 is the previous swing low where resting orders sit (0.8R). T2 848.65 is 2R and T3 842.65 is 3R. Take part profit at T1 and let the rest run with a trailing stop.

logic.title: Cautions
logic.text: Check the news and results date for this stock; Limited room to the prior low.

execution: Size: quantity = risk in rupees divided by 6. Check the stock's margin and make sure the trade fits your daily loss limit.
Order: SELL SHORT HDFCBANK (MIS) with a limit order at 860.60. If the next 5m candle closes below the trigger candle's extreme without filling, skip it.
Protect at once: SL-M (or SL-L) at 866.60.
Targets: half at T1 855.60, a quarter at T2 848.65, trail the rest. No new entries after 14:45.

trail.action: Stop at 866.60.
Book half. Move the stop to entry 860.60.
Book a quarter. Move the stop to T1 855.60.
Trail under each new 5m lower high, or exit on a 5m close above the 9 EMA.
Square off whatever is left. Brokers auto-square MIS around 15:15 to 15:20 and charge for it.
Exit at the market. A setup that does not move is a setup that failed.

rules: Never widen the stop.
Stop for the day after two losses.
Skip the first 15 minutes of the session.
